content.title: About
content.content: Baby Toddler apples, Stage 2 are soft, pre‑peeled apple pieces designed for children aged 6 to 12 months. The apples are grown without pesticides, steam‑treated, and cut into bite‑size pieces that are easy for tiny hands to grasp.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Apples are one of the first fruits introduced to infants because of their natural sweetness and soft texture.
Stage 2 pieces are lightly dried, which extends shelf life while retaining most vitamins.
Apple skin contains pectin, which supports a healthy gut microbiome.
Apples are rich in antioxidants, especially quercetin, which helps the immune system.
These pieces are conveniently packaged in sealed bags that prevent sticking.

items.title: Vitamin C
items.content: Apples provide vitamin C, which supports immunity and aids iron absorption.

items.title: Dietary Fiber
items.content: Pectin helps regulate bowel movements and prevents constipation in babies.

items.title: Low Sugar Content
items.content: Compared with many fruit purees, these pieces have a moderate natural sugar level, suitable for early feeding.

items.title: Potassium
items.content: Potassium contributes to normal muscle and nerve development.

items.title: Antioxidants
items.content: Flavonoids protect cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Allergy
items.content: A small number of infants may develop an allergic reaction to apples; monitor closely at first introduction.

items.title: Choking Hazard
items.content: Although soft, the pieces can still pose a choking risk for children under 6 months.

items.title: Fruit Acids
items.content: Some babies may experience mild mouth irritation due to natural fruit acids.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Offer 1–2 pieces at a time, allowing the child to hold them with their fingers. They can also be mixed into baby cereal or yogurt for variety.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place in the original sealed bag. After opening, use within 2–3 days or keep refrigerated.
